fixture.interpretation: Fixture mode replays hand-written scripted replies for the single_call, agent and agent_no_expand arms, including deliberately planted failures. Those rows validate the loop, policy and scorer; they are not measurements of any model. The lexical arm uses no model, so its fixture rows are genuine measurements of that baseline on this corpus.

live.interpretation: v1 pilot on the held-out family, agentcore 0.1.1 (strict reply parser).

live_v2.interpretation: v2 round on the fresh heldout_v2 family, agentcore 0.1.2 (parser accepts trailing text after a complete JSON reply). Same model, prompts and caps as v1.

live_v2_sonnet.interpretation: v2 round, second model on the same heldout_v2 questions: the agent arm, the strongest v1 baseline (single call) and the lexical baseline, one run.

limitations: The corpus is small (24 fictional documents, 16 questions) and written by the author; it is a test bed, not a benchmark.
Citation checks prove quote identity and provenance, not scientific support; support is scored against hand-written gold spans with a 50 percent overlap rule.
Condition recall is a substring check over the answer's conditions, claim and rationale.
Fixture results for model arms are scripted and carry no information about model quality.

Each live run covers 10 held-out questions at temperature 0 (two runs per arm for gpt-4.1-mini, one for the second model): exploratory samples, not a ranking. Run-to-run spread is shown as min and max.

reproduce.fixture: python -m evidence_ledger_agent evaluate --config configs/fixture.yaml && python -m evidence_ledger_agent report --update-readme
reproduce.live: git checkout 9d07e38 && python -m evidence_ledger_agent evaluate --config configs/live.yaml --require-live
reproduce.live_v2_sonnet: python -m evidence_ledger_agent evaluate --config configs/live_v2_sonnet.yaml --require-live && python -m evidence_ledger_agent report --update-readme
